Subject to client approval and agreement on the settlement amount, the revised draft adopts payment within ten business days after execution by both parties, by wire to Plaintiff’s designated account with independently verified instructions. It also limits the release to claims arising from the underlying dispute through execution, makes the release effective upon receipt of cleared funds, and expressly preserves enforcement rights. We have retained the confidentiality provision unchanged. We are seeking client authority for an opening monetary proposal and will revert once authorized. Please also confirm a mutually acceptable description of the underlying dispute for the recital.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims arising out of [IDENTIFY UNDERLYING DISPUTE] (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] within ten business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall promptly provide wire instructions, which Defendant shall independently verify with Plaintiff or Plaintiff’s counsel using previously established contact information before transmitting payment.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt in cleared funds of the full settlement amount required under Section 1, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims, whether known or unknown, arising out of the Dispute and based on acts, omissions, or events occurring on or before the date this Agreement has been executed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or impair either party’s rights to enforce this Agreement.
